preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 railway sections provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct valid station indices.
The number of passenger queries m is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 1 <= g <= 10**6 for a, b, g in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies distinct valid stations and a beauty value between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(f_values) == n - 1 and all(1 <= f <= 10**6 for f in f_values) and all(min(f_values[i] for i in path_edges(a, b)) == g for (a, b, g) in queries))
postconditions.description: Output is either -1 if no solution exists, or a list of n-1 integers where each is between 1 and 10^6, and for every query (a, b, g), the minimum value among the edges on the unique path between a and b equals g.
